translation_history.description: The King James Bible was first published in 1611. Later printing, spelling, and punctuation standardization—especially the Oxford edition associated with Benjamin Blayney in 1769—forms the general editorial basis commonly identified as the 1611 / 1769 KJV.

repository_provenance.corpus_origin: A maintained repository corpus developed and corrected through the project's version-control history.

verification.reference: Bible SuperSearch KJV module 6.2.0, identified by that provider as Authorized King James Version, 1611 / 1769
verification.method: The repository corpus was compared verse-by-verse with a temporary provider download. Rendering annotations were extracted into separate marker sidecars. The provider download and comparison report are not repository artifacts.

text_format.plain_text: Verse strings do not contain paragraph, added-word, or red-letter markup.
text_format.marker_offsets: Zero-based Unicode code-point offsets with exclusive end positions.
